A musical note is independent content inside a monitor screen, and a separate speaker overlaps the screen. Three identifiable parts require three independent briefs.

## Visual draft

A desktop monitor displays two joined musical notes above its lower bezel and central stand. A tall rounded speaker overlaps the screen on the right, with two circular drivers stacked vertically.

## 1. Desktop monitor frame (container)

A desktop monitor has a rounded screen enclosure, lower bezel, and central pedestal stand. Exclude the musical notes and separate speaker.

## 2. Joined musical notes (sub)

Two upright stems with rounded noteheads join through a sloping top beam. Exclude the monitor and speaker.

## 3. Tall two driver speaker (solo)

A tall rounded rectangular speaker contains two circular drivers, the lower larger than the upper. Exclude the monitor and musical notes.
